dedupe_keys.name: comune di lavagna fabbricati attivi imu

description: Comune di Lavagna publishes this inventory of registered buildings, described as Fabbricati attivi IMU, through the Maggioli open data catalogue. The exact table metadata lists cadastral identifiers Sezione, Foglio, Particella and Subalterno, followed by Rendita, Consistenza, Categoria and Classe. The source therefore describes building records with cadastral category and class attributes. It does not define units or interpretations for Rendita and Consistenza in the reviewed metadata. Coverage follows the publishing municipality; geographic completeness has not been checked. One CSV distribution is listed. The package and CSV distribution declare CC BY 4.0. Metadata is publicly readable, but the reviewed source does not state file-use charges. The inspected schema provides no coordinates, geometry, floor-area units, structural properties or energy measurements. A specific simulation application is not documented, so no simulation method is assigned. The declared update frequency is weekly; operation has not been independently checked. Accuracy and individual attribute values remain unverified. The source supplies no explicit related-resource links. Only field and catalogue metadata were read; no building rows or file bodies were obtained.
